review.review_type: Independent read-only artifact and numerical review
review.scope: Frozen chemistry-estimator fidelity Arena only; no model/objective forward or backward recomputation, no training, and no production edits.

evidence.sampling_check: Independent per-DB permutation streams, without replacement; K1/K2/K4 are exact nested prefixes shared across states. Manifest contains catalog and seeds only; samples do not depend on gold-gradient values.
evidence.geometry_binding: For every state, saved raw_original equals its SHA-bound geometry raw array. Historical raw_original[0] is the original sampled chemistry gradient and is reconstructed from the original batch; g_full251 is a separate SHA-bound gold full-251 gradient used for true-progress scoring.
evidence.independent_method: Pure NumPy replay from cached F64 singleton gradients; rebuilt each stratified estimator and solved the normalized four-task simplex minimum-norm problem by enumerating all 15 faces.
evidence.true_progress_comparison_tolerance: All 576 vector comparisons pass the frozen validator tolerance rtol=1e-10, atol=2e-13; the independent face-enumeration solve has a maximum absolute floating-point replay difference of 2.39e-13.
evidence.execution_mutation_receipts: All 12 state receipts report unchanged model state and RNG; the frozen-source hash inventory and artifact validator pass.

K8.reason: Exact K-per-DB sampling without replacement is impossible for ABDE4, which contains 4 canonical reactions.

qualification.failures_retained: All non-descent rows remain in the structured per-replicate results and summary; the 16-draw state rates and the p_full lower-tail counts agree with the frozen gate.

interpretation_limits: The 95% value is an empirical success-frequency threshold, not a statistical confidence guarantee. The 192 state/draw records share paired draws and are not independent population replicates.
This result is limited to the 12 frozen states and 16 preregistered draws. It does not establish trajectory or long-horizon training behavior, general estimator bias, or initializer preference.
Exact K-per-DB was preserved. K8 is infeasible and was not converted to an up-to-K design; K1/K2/K4 are the only evaluated candidates.

Per-replicate reaction-gradient counts are 8/16/32 for K1/K2/K4, but the audit computed singleton gradients once and reuses them across K and replicates. FULL251 runtime is projected from measured singleton timings rather than an end-to-end benchmark.
No K qualifies; the proposed next step is read-only per-database variance/control-variate feasibility analysis, not a K escalation or optimizer change.

qualification.tail_rule: No normalized true fullchem progress below -0.02; inherited offline Arena Tier2 safety boundary, frozen before evaluation.

strict_policy_confirmation.answer: Keep the exact K-per-DB requirement; mark K=8 infeasible and evaluate K=1/2/4 only
